metadata.title: Tomato Kangsoi | Manipuri Recipe
metadata.description:
Kamen Asimba Kangsoi
A very popular Manipuri recipe, which can be made with a variety of ingredients. This is a very simple Tomato and Potato based kansoi, which can be made ready in minutes and served. 

Ingredients required
Potatoes – 2 medium sized 
Tomatoes – 2 medium sized
Fermented (or dried, smoked, fried fish) – 3-4 small ones
Ginger – 1 inch piece
Coriander
Salt to taste

Preparation:

• Peel the potatoes or slice them along with the peel.
• Boil some water in a cooking vessel and drop in the sliced potatoes.
• When the potatoes are almost cooked, add cut tomatoes, slit green chillies and dried fish and allow them to cook.
• Add the sliced ginger towards the before you turn off the heat.
• Turn off the stove and garnish with coriander.

Thank you for watching, hope you make this dish at home and enjoy a hearty meal. ....
